fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UsedTruck/UsedTruckPdp.cy.js#UsedTruck - UsedTruckPdp [en] — Used Truck Detail TC-UTPDP-02: Contact Seller lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Used Truck Detail
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-UTPDP-02
**Title:** Contact Seller lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Used Truck Detail
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open a used-truck detail page, click Contact Seller, and submit with name, mobile and city all left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real required-field validation messages for name, mobile and location are shown, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open a used-truck detail page
2. Click Contact Seller
3. Leave name, mobile and city empty and submit
4. Verify the three required-field messages
